svg.title: EPOS technical system architecture
svg.desc: C4-style architecture diagram showing the React browser runtime, FastAPI application deployment unit, security and service components, deterministic Python engines, SQLite and PostgreSQL persistence, governed Azure OpenAI integration, runtime configuration, legacy Streamlit interface, and build and verification plane.
svg.text: C4-style container and component view · runtime, trust boundaries, persistence, AI integration and build plane
No scoring logic · no backend credentials
Backend-only · never bundled into the SPA
Runnable locally · excluded from hosted package
Python 3.11+ · FastAPI · Uvicorn · one ASGI process
Hashed assets · SPA fallback · cache policy
Compiled React application served on the API origin
Routers · schemas · exception mapping · health probes
Typed HTTP boundary; no independent score calculation
Protected requests: verify token → current user → permission → project scope
Authoritative calculations · explicit analysis date · source IDs
No SQL · no writes · no authoritative calculations
Backend checks source IDs; human review remains required
Development startup migration · no concurrent cold-start migration
Python web runtime + PostgreSQL + env secrets
Logical components, not microservices · HTTP locally; HTTPS for hosted ingress · SQLite verified locally · PostgreSQL deployment not verified.
AI-generated decision-support draft; human review required.
